title: "Data Quality Indicators"
format: html

resources:

---

We assigned data quality scores to crop groups within each country across three dimensions: spatial (administrative level reached), temporal (updating periodicity of data) and taxonomic (number of unique crops reported for a crop group).


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
countries_df <- read.csv("data/countries.csv", sep = ";", header = TRUE)

cat('<div class="country-selector">\n')
cat('<label for="country-input">Select a country:</label>\n')
cat('<div class="combobox">\n')
cat('<input type="text" id="country-input" placeholder="Write or click to see all options..." autocomplete="off">\n')
cat('<ul id="country-dropdown" class="country-dropdown"></ul>\n')
cat('</div>\n')
cat('</div>\n')

cat('<script id="country-data" type="application/json">\n')
json_items <- sprintf('{"name":"%s","code":"%s"}', countries_df$name, countries_df$code)
cat(sprintf('[%s]\n', paste(json_items, collapse = ",")))
cat('</script>\n')
```

::: scores-display
<img alt="Selected country data quality indicators" id="country-quality" style="display:none;"/>

<p id="country-placeholder">

</p>

<p id="country-error" style="display:none; color:#b00;">


</p>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
const allCountries = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('country-data').textContent);
const input = document.getElementById('country-input');
const dropdown = document.getElementById('country-dropdown');
const img = document.getElementById('country-quality');
const placeholder = document.getElementById('country-placeholder');
const errorMsg = document.getElementById('country-error');
let highlightedIndex = -1;
let currentOptions = [];
let selectedCode = null; // guardamos el code del país seleccionado

function renderDropdown(options) {
  currentOptions = options;
  highlightedIndex = -1;
  dropdown.innerHTML = '';
  if (options.length === 0) {
    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  options.forEach((country, i) => {
    const li = document.createElement('li');
    li.textContent = country.name;
    li.dataset.index = i;
    li.addEventListener('click', () => {
      input.value = country.name;
      selectedCode = country.code;
      closeDropdown();
      searchCountry();
    });
    dropdown.appendChild(li);
  });
  dropdown.style.display = 'block';
}

function openFullList() {
  renderDropdown(allCountries);
}

function filterList(text) {
  const term = text.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (term === '') {
    openFullList();
    return;
  }
  const filtered = allCountries.filter(c => c.name.toLowerCase().includes(term));
  renderDropdown(filtered);
}

function closeDropdown() {
  dropdown.style.display = 'none';
  highlightedIndex = -1;
}

function updateHighlight() {
  const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li');
  items.forEach((li, i) => {
    li.classList.toggle('highlighted', i === highlightedIndex);
  });
  if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && items[highlightedIndex]) {
    items[highlightedIndex].scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }
}

input.addEventListener('click', () => {
  openFullList();
});
input.addEventListener('input', () => {
  selectedCode = null; // si escribe manualmente, invalidamos la selección previa
  filterList(input.value);
});
input.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  const items = dropdown.querySelectorAll('li');
  if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
    e.preventDefault();
    highlightedIndex = Math.min(highlightedIndex + 1, items.length - 1);
    updateHighlight();
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    highlightedIndex = Math.max(highlightedIndex - 1, 0);
    updateHighlight();
  } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (highlightedIndex >= 0 && currentOptions[highlightedIndex]) {
      const chosen = currentOptions[highlightedIndex];
      input.value = chosen.name;
      selectedCode = chosen.code;
      closeDropdown();
    }
    searchCountry();
  } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
    closeDropdown();
  }
});
document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  if (!e.target.closest('.combobox')) {
    closeDropdown();
  }
});

function searchCountry() {
  closeDropdown();

  // Si no hay code guardado (usuario escribió texto libre), buscamos coincidencia exacta por nombre
  if (!selectedCode) {
    const match = allCountries.find(c => c.name.toLowerCase() === input.value.trim().toLowerCase());
    selectedCode = match ? match.code : null;
  }

  if (selectedCode) {
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    errorMsg.style.display = 'none';
    img.style.display = 'block';
    img.src = `images/${selectedCode}.png`;
    img.alt = `Country data quality scores: ${input.value}`;
  } else {
    img.style.display = 'none';
    placeholder.style.display = 'none';
    errorMsg.style.display = 'block';
  }
}
</script>
```
